node_types.name: Engine
node_types.definition: An internal control-plane engine implementing one decision concern within pool_membership_manager: pure decision logic that proposes pool_registry transitions through a CAS-gated commit path.

node_types.name: CommitGate
node_types.definition: An internal sequencer that owns the per-(chain, fork_id) pool_registry shard CAS line: serializes all admit/evict/quarantine/drain-fence/rebalance proposals from the engines, enforces priority lanes, and exposes the atomic re-check primitive used by override commits.

node_types.name: EvidenceStore
node_types.definition: A durable store internal to pool_membership_manager that holds evidence the engines and the commit gate need: phase-marker records, override audit trail, roster cache with HLC-bounded freshness witness.

node_types.name: BroadcastConsumer
node_types.definition: An internal consumer subservice that receives a signed broadcast from outside chain_router (lifecycle_gate drain-fence, region_coordinator roster), verifies it as a self-contained credential bundle, and hands the verified payload to engines/commit gate.

node_types.name: DispatchGuard
node_types.definition: An internal guard subservice that inspects every dispatched RPC before it leaves pool_membership_manager: cost-class hint presence, replica-class match, fork_id re-validation; refuses or rebounds on mismatch.

nodes.definition: Owns admit/evict lifecycle decisions for replicas in (chain, fork_id) sub-pools: proposes admitted/draining/evicted/quarantined transitions through commit_sequencer; gates admit on drain-completed-or-aborted and evict on drain-completed by reading the replica's drain_state_log entry; refuses re-admission of a draining replica unless an explicit drain-abort transition has been committed first. Refuses any quarantine eviction whose commit would push the (chain, fork_id) sub-pool's healthy-replica count below the documented safe-membership floor; refusal surfaces an alert with the (chain, fork_id) at risk. Floor check takes the same per-(chain, fork_id) shard CAS lock as the proposed commit (cannot use a denominator from a watermark older than the proposal's submission_hlc). For bulk-wave admits, the floor check is computed against the projected post-wave state for that wave_id (admitted-in-wave-so-far minus evicted-in-wave-so-far on the (chain, fork_id) shard) so transient inversions during the wave do not refuse admits that converge to safe state by wave-completion. Refuses admit of a tip-class request to an archive-only replica and vice versa (consults replica_health_register's replica-class records). On drain_fence_consumer feed, flushes in-flight audit writes for tenant T to compliance_audit by enumerating across the union of prior_fork_id and new_fork_id sub-pool views during a fork-transition mid-reshape (reads both shard summaries through commit_sequencer and continues enumeration across reshape commits using commit_hlc_watermark), then proposes drain-ack via commit_sequencer's drain-fence-priority lane within the HLC-bounded ack window. Writes phase-markers RECEIVED/FLUSH-IN-PROGRESS/FLUSH-COMPLETE/ACK-EMITTED/ATTESTATION-WRITTEN/TERMINAL-* through commit_sequencer; writes exactly one typed terminal attestation per class to compliance_audit under the (offboarding_id, component_id, attempt_id) idempotency key.

Owns the operator-override admission path used during emergency rollover when normal blue/green admit cannot keep up with replica loss: enforces M-of-N operator quorum signatures on the admit proposal; rejects proposals whose signing roster_version predates the currently-effective roster_version; verifies override at commit time against region_coordinator's currently-active roster_version through a named-roster lookup (NEVER from roster_cache, which is purely the freshness-witness for the deny-by-default gate); attaches a CAS witness to every commit proposal consisting of (named-roster_version observed at commit-time lookup, retroactive-as-of-HLC frontier observed for every signing credential at lookup time); commit_sequencer's atomic re-check refuses commit unless the witness's roster_version equals the currently-effective roster_version AND the witness's retroactive-as-of-HLC frontier is no older than the latest compromise-revocation observed for any signing credential at re-check time. Falls to deny-by-default sticky-until-newer-roster-acks when roster_cache is older than the documented HLC-bounded freshness window or empty. Maintains TWO separate counters: an operator-emergency override counter (max-overrides-per-window) that surfaces alerts on approach and rejects beyond, and a bulk_admit counter for lifecycle_gate-driven bulk-wave admits whose budget is parent-scope; bulk-wave admits do NOT consume the operator-emergency counter so emergency headroom is preserved during bulk waves. Records signing operators with the admit commit through phase_marker_journal as OVERRIDE-PROPOSED (with witness fingerprint) and OVERRIDE-COMMITTED only after commit_sequencer's atomic re-check accepts the witness; on restart an OVERRIDE-PROPOSED without OVERRIDE-COMMITTED is replayed only after re-acquiring a fresh witness.

Owns the quarantine eviction proposal path: consumes parent-scope quarantine_set divergence evidence and proposes per-replica eviction-to-quarantined transitions through commit_sequencer. Refuses any commit that would push the (chain, fork_id) sub-pool below the safe-membership floor (floor check shard-CAS-locked alongside the proposal so it cannot use a stale denominator). Respects schema_skew_quarantine's per-(chain, fork_id) max-concurrent-quarantine-commits cap; deferred-quarantines wait until drain-fence ACK-EMITTED on the same shard. Surfaces a deferred-quarantine alert keyed by (chain, fork_id, replica_id, deferral_started_hlc) — fires when ANY deferral has been pending longer than the documented threshold regardless of commit churn caused by health flaps; replay-safe across phase_marker_journal restart. Surfaces deferred-quarantine state into replica_health_register so the effective_capacity_calculator excludes deferred-quarantine replicas from the denominator.

Owns per-(chain, fork_id) sub-pool composition: maintains the documented target-capacity surface; when traffic share for a sub-pool exceeds its target by a documented margin, proposes membership rebalances (admit additional replicas of that fork; drain over-provisioned rare-fork replicas) gated on the safe-membership floor for both source and destination sub-pools. Rebalance proposals enter commit_sequencer's rebalance lane (separate ordered queue from bulk-wave admits and overrides) so bulk-wave traffic cannot starve rebalances. On fork_detection_alerter signal of sub-pool repartition for (chain, prior_fork_id, new_fork_id), the reshape is a single multi-row CAS through commit_sequencer that atomically transitions all prior_fork_id memberships to new_fork_id sub-pool memberships under one shard CAS line per (chain, fork_id_pair); commit_sequencer rejects partial reshape commits and the engine retries from scratch on conflict. The reshape commit sets the shard's fork_transition_state to reshape-committed-handshake-pending, blocking dispatch_validator's forward-progress until handshake-acked is committed by the parent scope on fanout-handshake-ack receipt.

Computes the effective-capacity denominator (count of replicas currently admitted AND not draining AND not in deferred-quarantine AND not tip-stale) for each (chain, fork_id) by reading per-shard summaries from replica_health_register CAS-lock-free via the published snapshot keyed by commit_hlc_watermark; recomputes on every relevant commit_sequencer transition (read-your-writes); propagates the denominator to sub_pool_fork_partitioner outside this scope so per-replica fan-out reflects the actually-serving subset.

Owns the per-(chain, fork_id) pool_registry shard CAS line for all admit/evict/quarantine/drain-fence/rebalance proposals from the engines: serializes proposals in shard order; carries an admission-class lane discriminator (drain-fence-priority, operator-emergency override, bulk-wave admit, rebalance admit, quarantine evict) — drain-fence-priority pre-empts all others; among non-priority lanes the sequencer round-robins within a documented per-shard fairness budget so bulk-wave admits cannot starve rebalance admits. Provides the atomic re-check primitive used by override_admission_engine: re-checks the proposal's CAS witness (named-roster_version, retroactive-as-of-HLC frontier per signing credential) against the currently-effective roster_version and against the sequenced revocation log read under the same CAS lock — refuses commit on stale witness so the activation race cannot slip in. Each shard summary is computed inside the CAS critical section on every commit and published to replica_health_register stamped with commit_hlc_watermark; readers consume the summary CAS-lock-FREE through a published snapshot whose watermark advances monotonically. The shard carries a fork_transition_state field (stable / reshape-committed-handshake-pending / handshake-acked) committed under the same CAS line — sub-pool reshape on fork-transition is a single multi-row CAS that atomically transitions all prior_fork_id memberships to new_fork_id; partial reshapes are rejected. Fences against fork-transition handshake state so it refuses to commit a drain-ack while a fork-transition handshake is mid-flight on any (chain, fork_id) shard whose audit writes for tenant T are in flight (extending the drain-fence ack-window HLC budget across handshake completion or rejecting with drain-fence-blocked-by-fork-transition attestation). Records every commit's signing operator identities (when override) and shard hlc_stamp.

Per-(chain, fork_id, replica_id) health register internal to pool_membership_manager: caches each replica's current lifecycle flags (admitted, draining, deferred-quarantine, tip-stale) read from per-shard pool_registry summaries; records replica-class (tip-serving / historical-archive / both); per-(chain, fork_id) shard summaries are computed inside commit_sequencer's CAS critical section on every commit and stamped with the shard's commit_hlc_watermark; readers (effective_capacity_calculator, admit_evict_engine, dispatch_validator) consume summaries CAS-LOCK-FREE through a published snapshot whose watermark advances monotonically — readers cannot block CAS commits. If a consumed watermark is older than a documented bound, the dispatch_validator bounces the dispatch as retryable rather than serving against stale state. Per-replica entries carry the hlc_stamp at which they were last refreshed, plus the wave_id-keyed running counts (admitted-in-wave, evicted-in-wave) used by admit_evict_engine for projected post-wave floor checks.

Durable journal of typed per-(offboarding_id, component_id, drain_id) phase-markers (RECEIVED, FLUSH-IN-PROGRESS, FLUSH-COMPLETE, ACK-EMITTED, ATTESTATION-WRITTEN, TERMINAL-ACK, TERMINAL-PRESERVATION-BLOCKED) maintained on every drain-fence broadcast accepted by this scope; on restart engines resume from the last durable phase, never re-run a non-idempotent phase, never retract a drain-ack; carries the canonical-writer-election CAS evidence shared with drain_coordinator's drain_state_log so attestation to compliance_audit is written exactly once per terminal class. Records OVERRIDE-PROPOSED with the CAS witness fingerprint and OVERRIDE-COMMITTED only after commit_sequencer's atomic re-check accepts the witness; M-of-N signing operator identities and the active roster_version are recorded for audit. The deferred-quarantine alert provenance is journalled keyed by (chain, fork_id, replica_id, deferral_started_hlc) so an alert fires when any deferral has been pending longer than the documented threshold even across crashes and even under flap-induced commit churn that does not reset the counter. Refusal alerts from dispatch_validator are NOT written here — they go to a separate refusal_alert_buffer.

Local cache of operator-credential rosters indexed by roster_version: every entry carries the freshness-witness hlc_stamp at which the roster was last received. PURELY a freshness witness for the override_admission_engine's deny-by-default gate (deny when older than the documented HLC-bounded freshness window or empty, sticky until a strictly-newer roster_version ack-readies). NEVER the source of any CAS witness or compromise-revocation evaluation: override commits source their witness from the named-roster lookup path; compromise-revocation evaluation reads commit_sequencer's sequenced revocation log fed by roster_broadcast_consumer.

Consumes lifecycle_gate-originated drain-fence broadcasts for tenant T as self-contained credential bundles naming roster_version V_named; on cache miss synchronously fetches V_named from region_coordinator over the cert-bearing inter-region surface bounded by an HLC budget tighter than the per-tenant ack window; coalesces fetches across a bulk-offboarding wave so N broadcasts trigger one fetch; on fetch failure rejects with a typed named-roster-unfetchable (single broadcast) or named-roster-fetch-failed-bulk (wave) attestation to compliance_audit. On verified broadcast feeds admit_evict_engine, which flushes audit writes for tenant T spanning the union of prior_fork_id and new_fork_id sub-pool views during a fork-transition mid-reshape, then proposes drain-ack via commit_sequencer's drain-fence-priority lane within the HLC-bounded ack window. drain_fence_consumer extends the ack-window HLC budget across handshake completion when commit_sequencer is fenced by a fork-transition-mid-flight or rejects with drain-fence-blocked-by-fork-transition. Writes RECEIVED phase-marker on accept and reads phase_marker_journal on restart for replay safety.

Consumes region_coordinator-originated roster updates and on-demand named-roster fetch responses; verifies the signed roster bundle under lifecycle-gate authority; refreshes roster_cache (the freshness witness only) with the new roster_version and freshness-witness hlc_stamp; PUBLISHES compromise-revocations to a sequenced revocation log read by commit_sequencer under the same shard CAS lock used for override commits — propagation is committed-versus-not, not eventually-visible; revocations carry the retroactive-as-of-HLC and the affected operator credential ids and are indexed by credential id for atomic re-check; the consumer is read-only with respect to the 2PC rotation flow at region_coordinator and never bypasses it.

Inspects every dispatched RPC at the moment of dispatch from pool_membership_manager to a replica: re-validates the replica's currently-recorded fork_id in replica_health_register (read CAS-lock-free via the published shard summary keyed by commit_hlc_watermark) against the request's (chain, fork_id) tag (mismatch returns retryable-on-other-replica); refuses any dispatch lacking a cost-class hint when the request type requires one (long-RPC archive paths); verifies the replica-class includes the request's class (tip-serving vs archive); never dispatches forward-progress on a new fork_id whose commit_sequencer shard fork_transition_state is reshape-committed-handshake-pending (only handshake-acked permits forward-progress); if the consumed shard summary watermark is older than a documented bound, bounces the dispatch as retryable-on-other-replica rather than serving against stale state. Refusal alerts (cost-class-less retry, replica-class mismatch, fork_id mismatch) are written OUT-OF-BAND to a refusal_alert_buffer drained asynchronously — never to phase_marker_journal under any shard CAS line. Refusal alert counters are keyed by (chain, fork_id, tenant_id, hlc_window) and per-tenant alert emission is rate-limited so one misconfigured tenant's storm cannot mask another tenant's anomaly.

Out-of-band asynchronous buffer for dispatch_validator's refusal alerts (cost-class-less retry, replica-class mismatch, fork_id mismatch): writes here never block commit_sequencer's CAS line and are drained asynchronously by an emitter outside this scope (parent chain_router observability). Counters are keyed by (chain, fork_id, tenant_id, hlc_window) and per-tenant alert emission is rate-limited so one misconfigured tenant's storm cannot mask another tenant's anomaly.

requirements.description: Admit/evict transitions are gated on the replica's drain_state_log entry: admit requires drain-completed-or-aborted, evict requires drain-completed; concurrent proposals are CAS-ordered through the per-(chain, fork_id) shard line so admit-during-drain or evict-after-readmit cannot both commit. Re-admission of a draining replica requires an explicit drain-abort transition before admit can commit.

Quarantine eviction proposals refuse to commit if the commit would push the (chain, fork_id) sub-pool's healthy-replica count below the documented safe-membership floor; refusal surfaces an alert with the (chain, fork_id) at risk and the candidate replica.

The effective-capacity denominator (admitted AND not draining AND not in deferred-quarantine AND not tip-stale) is computed from per-shard summaries on every relevant transition and propagated to sub_pool_fork_partitioner outside this scope so per-replica fan-out reflects the actually-serving subset rather than total pool_registry membership.

Admit refuses tip-class request to an archive-only replica and vice versa; dispatch refuses to send a tip-class request to an archive-only replica and vice versa, consulting per-replica replica-class records.
Refuses any dispatch lacking a cost-class hint when the request type requires one (long-RPC archive paths) and surfaces an alert if a cost-class-less retry arrives at dispatch.

On dispatch the dispatch validator re-validates the replica's currently-recorded fork_id against the request's (chain, fork_id) tag at the moment of dispatch (not just at routing-table read time); a mismatch returns a retryable-on-other-replica signal.

Maintains per-(chain, fork_id) target-capacity surface; when traffic share exceeds target by a documented margin, proposes membership rebalances gated on safe-membership floor for both source and destination sub-pools, committed via the same CAS path. On fork_detection_alerter signal, commits new sub-pool membership before chain_router admits the fork-transition handshake to fanout.

Operator-override admission requires M-of-N operator quorum signatures on the admit proposal; signing operators are recorded with the admit commit and visible in audit. The credential model and key custody are parent scope's responsibility.

Override-commit verifies the proposal against region_coordinator's currently-active roster_version (named-roster lookup, not local cache) at commit time, including evaluation of any retroactive-as-of-HLC compromise-revocation predating the proposal's submission HLC; commit fails closed if any signing credential is retroactively revoked. Pre-commit roster_version is re-checked atomically with the pool_registry CAS commit.

Enforces a documented max-overrides-per-window rate limit on operator-override admissions that bypass the safe-membership floor; approaching the limit surfaces an alert; exceeding it rejects further override admits with a documented error code.

Override path falls to deny-by-default when the cached roster is older than the documented HLC-bounded freshness window or when no roster has ever been received; deny is sticky for that override path until a strictly-newer roster_version ack-readies.

Rejects override proposals whose signing roster_version predates the currently-effective roster_version; refuses to commit overrides after a compromise-revocation invalidates any in-flight signature including retroactive-as-of-HLC compromise-revocations; cancel-and-rollback for in-flight proposals is performed atomically at activation by roster_version.

Drain-fence broadcasts for tenant T are consumed as self-contained credential bundles, signature verified against the broadcast's NAMED roster_version (via on-demand named-roster fetch from region_coordinator when V_named is strictly newer than the cache, bounded by an HLC budget tighter than the per-tenant ack window; bulk waves coalesce); on fetch failure rejects with named-roster-unfetchable / named-roster-fetch-failed-bulk attestation. On verified broadcast: flushes in-flight audit writes for T to compliance_audit and acks drain to tenant_store within the HLC-bounded ack window.

Drain-fence flush is admitted on a separate priority lane than quarantine commits on the per-(chain, fork_id) shard CAS line: drain-fence transitions are tagged drain-fence-priority and pre-empt deferred-quarantine commits; deferred-quarantines wait until drain-fence ACK-EMITTED. Surfaces an alert when quarantine deferral grows under drain-fence pressure.

Drain-fence flush is fenced against fork-transition handshake state: refuses to commit a drain-ack while a fork-transition handshake is mid-flight on any (chain, fork_id) shard whose audit writes for tenant T are in flight; ack-window HLC budget extends across handshake completion or the broadcast is rejected with a typed drain-fence-blocked-by-fork-transition attestation. Flush enumerates audit writes by tenant_id across both pre- and post-transition sub-pool views.

Maintains durable per-(offboarding_id, component_id, drain_id) phase-markers (RECEIVED, FLUSH-IN-PROGRESS, FLUSH-COMPLETE, ACK-EMITTED, ATTESTATION-WRITTEN, TERMINAL-ACK, TERMINAL-PRESERVATION-BLOCKED); on restart resumes from the last durable phase, never re-runs a non-idempotent phase, never retracts a drain-ack.

Each terminal class (TERMINAL-ACK / TERMINAL-PRESERVATION-BLOCKED) writes exactly one typed attestation to compliance_audit under the (offboarding_id, component_id, attempt_id) idempotency key; canonical writer election by drain_state_log CAS shared with drain_coordinator outside this scope so the attestation is written exactly once.

On fork_detection_alerter signal of sub-pool repartition for (chain, fork_id), the new sub-pool's membership must be committed in pool_registry through the commit sequencer BEFORE chain_router-level routing-table fence admits the new fork and BEFORE chain_router-level fork-transition handshake to fanout; dispatch validator never dispatches forward-progress on a new fork_id whose commit sequencer shard has not yet recorded the fanout-handshake-ack.

Replica-health register entries are refreshed from each commit sequencer transition and carry the hlc_stamp at which they were last refreshed; effective-capacity calculator and dispatch validator consume per-(chain, fork_id) summaries from the register rather than scanning pool_registry directly.

Override admission proposals carry a CAS witness consisting of (named-roster_version observed at the engine's commit-time lookup, retroactive-as-of-HLC frontier observed for every signing credential at lookup time). commit_sequencer's atomic re-check refuses to commit any override unless the witness's roster_version EQUALS the currently-effective roster_version AND the witness's retroactive-as-of-HLC frontier is no older than the latest compromise-revocation observed for any signing credential at re-check time. The witness is recorded with the admit commit and is replay-safe.

roster_broadcast_consumer publishes compromise-revocations through a sequenced revocation log read by commit_sequencer under the same CAS lock used for override commits, so revocation propagation is committed-versus-not rather than eventually-visible; revocations carry the retroactive-as-of-HLC and the affected operator credential ids, and commit_sequencer indexes the log by credential id for atomic re-check.

phase_marker_journal records OVERRIDE-PROPOSED with the CAS witness fingerprint at submission and OVERRIDE-COMMITTED only after commit_sequencer's atomic re-check accepts the witness; on restart, an OVERRIDE-PROPOSED without OVERRIDE-COMMITTED is replayed only after the engine re-acquires a fresh witness, never with the stale one.

roster_cache MUST NOT be the source of any CAS witness or compromise-revocation evaluation: it acts only as the freshness-witness for the deny-by-default override gate. Override commits source their witness from the named-roster lookup path, never from roster_cache.

replica_health_register's per-(chain, fork_id) shard summary is computed inside commit_sequencer's CAS critical section on every commit and stamped with the shard's commit_hlc_watermark; effective_capacity_calculator, admit_evict_engine, and dispatch_validator consume the summary through a read-your-writes path keyed by the watermark, so readers cannot consume a summary older than the most recent commit on that shard.

admit_evict_engine's safe-membership-floor read for any proposed eviction takes the same per-(chain, fork_id) shard CAS lock as the proposed commit, so the floor check cannot use an effective-capacity denominator from a watermark older than the proposal's submission_hlc; quarantine_eviction_engine's floor check is similarly shard-locked.

quarantine_eviction_engine's deferred-quarantine alert is keyed by (chain, fork_id, replica_id, deferral_started_hlc) and fires when any deferral has been pending longer than the documented threshold, regardless of commit churn caused by health flaps; the alert is replay-safe across phase_marker_journal restart so a deferral aged across crashes still surfaces.

sub_pool_composition_engine's sub-pool reshape on fork-transition is a single multi-row CAS commit through commit_sequencer that atomically transitions all prior_fork_id memberships to new_fork_id sub-pool memberships under one shard CAS line per (chain, fork_id_pair); commit_sequencer rejects partial reshape commits and the engine retries from scratch on conflict, so admit_evict_engine and dispatch_validator never observe partial reshape state.

Each per-(chain, fork_id) shard in commit_sequencer carries a fork_transition_state field (stable / reshape-committed-handshake-pending / handshake-acked) committed under the same shard CAS line; dispatch_validator reads this field and refuses forward-progress dispatch on new_fork_id when state is reshape-committed-handshake-pending.

drain_fence_consumer's flush enumeration for tenant T spans the union of prior_fork_id and new_fork_id sub-pool views during a fork-transition mid-reshape: reads both shard summaries through commit_sequencer and continues enumeration across reshape commits using the commit_hlc_watermark, so audit writes in flight against the prior view are not missed.

dispatch_validator's refusal alert path (cost-class-less retry, replica-class mismatch, fork_id mismatch alerts) is out-of-band relative to commit_sequencer: refusals write to a separate refusal_alert_buffer drained asynchronously and never write to phase_marker_journal under any shard CAS line, so refusal-storm cannot starve commit-path phase-marker writes.

Per-(chain, fork_id) shard summary reads from replica_health_register are CAS-lock-free: readers consume a published summary snapshot whose commit_hlc_watermark advances monotonically; readers cannot block CAS commits, AND if the consumed watermark is older than a documented bound the dispatch is bounced as retryable-on-other-replica rather than served against stale state.

The cost-class-less retry alert counter (and the replica-class mismatch alert counter) is keyed by (chain, fork_id, tenant_id, hlc_window) and per-tenant alert emission is rate-limited so one misconfigured tenant's storm cannot mask another tenant's anomaly.

commit_sequencer's per-(chain, fork_id) shard CAS line carries an admission-class lane discriminator: bulk-wave admits, operator-emergency override admits, rebalance admits, and quarantine evictions are routed to separate ordered queues; drain-fence-priority lane pre-empts the rest; the sequencer round-robins across non-priority lanes within a documented per-shard fairness budget so bulk-wave admits cannot starve rebalance admits and rebalance-stuck cannot be triggered by sustained bulk-wave traffic alone.

override_admission_engine's max-overrides-per-window counter distinguishes operator-emergency overrides from bulk_admitter-driven admits: bulk-wave admits do NOT consume the emergency override counter — they consume a separate bulk_admit counter whose budget contract is parent-scope (bubbled). Operator-emergency override headroom is preserved during bulk-eviction waves.

admit_evict_engine's safe-membership-floor check on a bulk-wave admit is computed against the projected post-wave state for that wave_id (admitted-in-wave-so-far minus evicted-in-wave-so-far on the (chain, fork_id) shard) rather than the instantaneous denominator, so transient inversions during the wave do not refuse admits that converge to safe state by wave-completion.

satisfactions.explanation: admit_evict_engine consults replica_health_register for the replica's drain state and proposes the transition through commit_sequencer; commit_sequencer serializes proposals on the per-(chain, fork_id) shard CAS line; admit_evict_engine refuses re-admit of a draining replica unless an explicit drain-abort transition has been committed first.

quarantine_eviction_engine refuses any commit that would push the (chain, fork_id) sub-pool below the safe-membership floor by reading replica_health_register summaries before proposing; admit_evict_engine mirrors the floor check on its own evictions; refusal surfaces an alert with the (chain, fork_id) at risk.

effective_capacity_calculator reads per-shard summaries from replica_health_register and recomputes the denominator on every commit_sequencer transition; the calculator propagates the denominator to sub_pool_fork_partitioner outside this scope.

replica_health_register records replica-class per replica; admit_evict_engine refuses tip-class admit on archive-only replica and vice versa; dispatch_validator consults the register and refuses dispatches whose replica-class does not include the request's class.
dispatch_validator inspects every dispatch and refuses any lacking a cost-class hint when the request type requires one; surfaces an alert if a cost-class-less retry arrives at dispatch.

dispatch_validator re-validates the replica's currently-recorded fork_id from replica_health_register against the request's (chain, fork_id) tag at the moment of dispatch; mismatch returns retryable-on-other-replica.

sub_pool_composition_engine maintains the target-capacity surface; consults replica_health_register and proposes rebalances through commit_sequencer gated on the floor for source and destination; on fork_detection_alerter signal commits new sub-pool membership through the commit sequencer.
override_admission_engine requires M-of-N operator quorum signatures on every override admit proposal; phase_marker_journal records the signing operator identities at commit.

override_admission_engine drives roster_broadcast_consumer's named-roster lookup at commit time and consults the named roster (not roster_cache) for retroactive-as-of-HLC compromise-revocation; commit_sequencer atomically re-checks roster_version with the pool_registry CAS commit so the activation race cannot slip in.
override_admission_engine tracks an internal max-overrides-per-window counter and rejects further override admits beyond the limit with a documented error code; alert at approach.
override_admission_engine reads roster_cache's freshness-witness hlc_stamp; when the cache is older than the documented window or empty, it falls to deny-by-default sticky-until-newer-roster-acks.

override_admission_engine rejects proposals whose signing roster_version predates the currently-effective roster_version; roster_broadcast_consumer propagates retroactive-as-of-HLC compromise-revocation that the engine consults at commit time so commits fail closed if any signing credential is retroactively revoked; cancel-and-rollback for in-flight proposals is performed atomically at activation by roster_version.

drain_fence_consumer treats every drain-fence broadcast as a self-contained credential bundle, fetches V_named on cache miss bounded by HLC budget tighter than the per-tenant ack window, coalesces fetches across bulk waves, emits typed attestations on fetch failure; on verified broadcast feeds admit_evict_engine which flushes in-flight audit writes for T to compliance_audit and proposes drain-ack via the commit sequencer's drain-fence-priority lane within the HLC-bounded ack window.

commit_sequencer enforces the drain-fence-priority lane on the per-(chain, fork_id) shard CAS line: drain-fence transitions pre-empt deferred-quarantine commits; quarantine_eviction_engine surfaces an alert when its deferred-quarantine queue grows under drain-fence pressure.

commit_sequencer refuses to commit a drain-ack while a fork-transition handshake is mid-flight on any (chain, fork_id) shard with audit writes for T in flight; drain_fence_consumer extends the ack-window HLC budget across handshake completion or rejects with a typed drain-fence-blocked-by-fork-transition attestation; flush enumerates audit writes by tenant_id across both pre- and post-transition sub-pool views.

phase_marker_journal persists durable typed phase-markers; drain_fence_consumer writes RECEIVED on broadcast accept and reads on restart; admit_evict_engine writes FLUSH-IN-PROGRESS / FLUSH-COMPLETE / ACK-EMITTED / ATTESTATION-WRITTEN / TERMINAL-* through commit_sequencer; restart resumes from the last durable phase and never re-runs a non-idempotent phase or retracts a drain-ack.

phase_marker_journal carries the canonical-writer-election CAS evidence shared with drain_coordinator's drain_state_log; admit_evict_engine writes exactly one typed attestation per terminal class to compliance_audit under the (offboarding_id, component_id, attempt_id) idempotency key.

sub_pool_composition_engine commits the new sub-pool's membership through commit_sequencer before any chain_router-level routing-table fence; dispatch_validator consults commit_sequencer's per-(chain, fork_id) shard state and refuses forward-progress dispatch on the new fork_id until the fanout-handshake-ack is recorded.

commit_sequencer writes refreshed entries to replica_health_register on every transition; effective_capacity_calculator and dispatch_validator both consume per-(chain, fork_id) summaries from the register; entries carry the hlc_stamp at which they were last refreshed.

override_admission_engine redefinition: 'attaches a CAS witness to every commit proposal consisting of (named-roster_version observed at commit-time lookup, retroactive-as-of-HLC frontier observed for every signing credential at lookup time)'. commit_sequencer redefinition: 'atomic re-check refuses commit unless the witness's roster_version equals the currently-effective roster_version AND the witness's retroactive-as-of-HLC frontier is no older than the latest compromise-revocation observed for any signing credential at re-check time'.

roster_broadcast_consumer redefinition: 'PUBLISHES compromise-revocations to a sequenced revocation log read by commit_sequencer under the same shard CAS lock used for override commits — propagation is committed-versus-not, not eventually-visible; revocations carry retroactive-as-of-HLC and affected operator credential ids and are indexed by credential id for atomic re-check'.

phase_marker_journal redefinition: 'records OVERRIDE-PROPOSED with the CAS witness fingerprint and OVERRIDE-COMMITTED only after commit_sequencer's atomic re-check accepts the witness'. override_admission_engine redefinition: 'on restart an OVERRIDE-PROPOSED without OVERRIDE-COMMITTED is replayed only after re-acquiring a fresh witness'.

roster_cache redefinition: 'PURELY a freshness witness... NEVER the source of any CAS witness or compromise-revocation evaluation'. override_admission_engine redefinition: 'verifies override at commit time against region_coordinator's currently-active roster_version through a named-roster lookup (NEVER from roster_cache)'.

commit_sequencer redefinition: 'each shard summary is computed inside the CAS critical section on every commit and published to replica_health_register stamped with commit_hlc_watermark'. replica_health_register redefinition: 'readers consume summaries CAS-LOCK-FREE through a published snapshot whose watermark advances monotonically'.

admit_evict_engine redefinition: 'floor check takes the same per-(chain, fork_id) shard CAS lock as the proposed commit (cannot use a denominator from a watermark older than the proposal's submission_hlc)'. quarantine_eviction_engine redefinition: 'floor check shard-CAS-locked alongside the proposal so it cannot use a stale denominator'.

quarantine_eviction_engine redefinition: 'surfaces a deferred-quarantine alert keyed by (chain, fork_id, replica_id, deferral_started_hlc) — fires when ANY deferral has been pending longer than the documented threshold regardless of commit churn caused by health flaps; replay-safe across phase_marker_journal restart'. phase_marker_journal redefinition: 'the deferred-quarantine alert provenance is journalled keyed by (chain, fork_id, replica_id, deferral_started_hlc)'.

sub_pool_composition_engine redefinition: 'on fork_detection_alerter signal of sub-pool repartition... the reshape is a single multi-row CAS through commit_sequencer that atomically transitions all prior_fork_id memberships to new_fork_id sub-pool memberships under one shard CAS line per (chain, fork_id_pair); commit_sequencer rejects partial reshape commits and the engine retries from scratch on conflict'.

commit_sequencer redefinition: 'the shard carries a fork_transition_state field (stable / reshape-committed-handshake-pending / handshake-acked) committed under the same CAS line'. dispatch_validator redefinition: 'never dispatches forward-progress on a new fork_id whose commit_sequencer shard fork_transition_state is reshape-committed-handshake-pending (only handshake-acked permits forward-progress)'.

drain_fence_consumer redefinition: 'admit_evict_engine flushes audit writes for tenant T spanning the union of prior_fork_id and new_fork_id sub-pool views during a fork-transition mid-reshape'. admit_evict_engine redefinition: 'flushes in-flight audit writes for tenant T to compliance_audit by enumerating across the union of prior_fork_id and new_fork_id sub-pool views during a fork-transition mid-reshape (reads both shard summaries through commit_sequencer and continues enumeration across reshape commits using commit_hlc_watermark)'.

dispatch_validator redefinition: 'refusal alerts are written OUT-OF-BAND to a refusal_alert_buffer drained asynchronously — never to phase_marker_journal under any shard CAS line'. New node refusal_alert_buffer captures this out-of-band path. phase_marker_journal redefinition explicitly excludes refusal alerts.

replica_health_register redefinition: 'readers... consume summaries CAS-LOCK-FREE through a published snapshot whose watermark advances monotonically — readers cannot block CAS commits. If a consumed watermark is older than a documented bound, the dispatch_validator bounces the dispatch as retryable rather than serving against stale state'. dispatch_validator redefinition mirrors the bound check.

dispatch_validator and refusal_alert_buffer redefinitions: 'refusal alert counters are keyed by (chain, fork_id, tenant_id, hlc_window) and per-tenant alert emission is rate-limited so one misconfigured tenant's storm cannot mask another tenant's anomaly'.

commit_sequencer redefinition: 'carries an admission-class lane discriminator (drain-fence-priority, operator-emergency override, bulk-wave admit, rebalance admit, quarantine evict) — drain-fence-priority pre-empts all others; among non-priority lanes the sequencer round-robins within a documented per-shard fairness budget so bulk-wave admits cannot starve rebalance admits'.

admit_evict_engine redefinition: 'for bulk-wave admits, the floor check is computed against the projected post-wave state for that wave_id (admitted-in-wave-so-far minus evicted-in-wave-so-far on the (chain, fork_id) shard) so transient inversions during the wave do not refuse admits that converge to safe state by wave-completion'. replica_health_register redefinition stores wave_id-keyed running counts.

override_admission_engine redefinition: 'maintains TWO separate counters: an operator-emergency override counter (max-overrides-per-window) that surfaces alerts on approach and rejects beyond, and a bulk_admit counter for lifecycle_gate-driven bulk-wave admits whose budget is parent-scope; bulk-wave admits do NOT consume the operator-emergency counter so emergency headroom is preserved during bulk waves'. The bulk_admit budget contract itself is bubbled to parent scope.
